1.desc: When Claret's attack hits an enemy and triggers a Sharp Explosion, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 15%; when the whole squad successfully applies Gash to an enemy, Claret's CRIT Rate increases by 5%, lasting 15 seconds, stacking up to 3 times; repeated triggers reset the duration.

2.desc: When Blood Blossom Oath skill attacks hit an enemy, ignore -35% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>; when the whole squad's skills trigger [Maim], Claret recovers 0.25 Sharpness. This can be triggered at most once per skill.

4.desc: When Claret is in the [Scarlet Inscription] state, performing a dodge will preserve her current Basic Attack combo count.
